description: Design the namespaced git trailer system: finalize trailer key names (Vrooli-Initiative, Vrooli-Backlog, Vrooli-Continues or alternatives), define how the 'continue' UX auto-populates trailers from previous commit, specify Swarm Manager API contract for fetching initiative metadata given a slug, define graceful degradation behavior when Swarm Manager is unavailable, evaluate git trailer parsing (git log --format='%(trailers:key=...)') for reliable extraction.
name: gct-trailer-system-design
title: Design Vrooli-namespaced trailer convention and Swarm Manager linkage
